subject: Acme: Pricing follow-up & invoice estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: quick recap + ask (token volumes, target $/1M)

Hi Jenna —

Great to meet earlier — quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get you a clean invoice estimate for the POC.

Recap from call:
- Expected workload: ~1.5B tokens/month (mix of generation + embeddings; roughly 70% gen / 30% embeddings)
- Target latency: p95 < 400ms for chat flows (mostly short-context interactions)
- Success metric for POC: equivalent quality to existing vendor + 20% lower cost/unit

Asks:
1) Can you confirm the 1.5B tokens/month estimate (or give a +/- range)?
2) Do you have a target $/1M tokens you want us to model to match your internal budget? (you mentioned $10–$20 earlier)
3) Any procurement constraints (PO terms, billing cadence, SOC2 evidence) we should include on the estimate?

Attached: acme_cost_model_v1.xlsx (working model), redwood_pricing_calculator.csv — I populated the model with today's assumptions to show how we get to an invoice.

Next steps: if you confirm volumes & target $/1M we’ll send a line-item invoice estimate and a backup cost breakdown (compute / infra / support). Happy to jump on a 30-min pricing review tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: acme_cost_model_v1.xlsx, redwood_pricing_calculator.csv

Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + ask (token volumes, target $/1M)

Thanks Sean —

Confirming rough volumes: 1.2–1.8B tokens/month depending on usage growth; 1.5B is a good planning number for the POC.

On budget, leadership expects the unit economics to be ~ $10–$15 per 1M tokens for the POC. If you can model $12–$15 we’ll be in good shape.

Procurement note: we typically require Net 30 and a PO for POC purchases > $10k. I’ve looped procurement on this email.

-Jenna

Date: 2026-06-12T11:33:00-07:00
Subject: Acme: Invoice estimate & cost breakdown (POC model)

Jenna / Team —

Thanks for confirming volumes and the target range. Attached is a concise invoice estimate and a slightly updated cost model (acme_cost_model_v2.xlsx). Key assumptions are called out in the first tab. I also exported a printable invoice estimate (invoice_estimate_20260612.pdf) for procurement.

High-level cost breakdown (POC, 1.5B tokens/month):
- Total estimated invoice: $18,000 / month (this models at $12 / 1M tokens)
- Line items (monthly):
  - Model serving (GPU cycles, reserved pool): $9,000
  - Token processing & bandwidth: $6,000
  - Observability / logs / KV cache storage: $1,000
  - Support & account management (SLAs, onboarding): $2,000

Notes on unit economics and discounts:
- The $12 / 1M token figure assumes Redwood hosted inference with continuous batching and prefix caching active — internal experiments show ~25–35% savings vs naive per-token charging on similar workloads.
- Committed Reserved (Redwood Dedicated) pricing can reduce the per-1M rate by an additional 15–30% depending on term and commit level; happy to model Dedicated scenarios if Acme expects steady-state volume after POC.
- One-time onboarding credit can offset first-month fees for the POC if needed.

Attachments: invoice_estimate_20260612.pdf, acme_cost_model_v2.xlsx

If procurement needs Net 30 and a PO we can produce a formal quote with PO line items and show Net 30 billing terms. Want to schedule a 30-min pricing review tomorrow to walk the estimate and the assumptions?

Thanks,
Sean

> Jenna: thanks for the quick confirm — I’ve included Vivek for any architecture questions and Laura for onboarding / CS notes.
